snippet.title: Redast – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
REDAST

Redast is an adrenaline-fueled survival experience that blends the horror and detective genres with co-op dynamics. Prepare to solve terrifying cases across the globe with your friends—from the prestigious museums of Europe to the mystical temples of the Far East, and from the ancient lands of the Middle East to the freezing silence of the Arctic.

Test Your Wit and Courage In the universe of Redast, 50 different supernatural entities, each with its own unique intelligence and behavior patterns, await you. Your adversary is not just an enemy; it is a hunter that tests you, monitors your movements, and forces you to adapt your strategy at every turn.

Observe, Predict, Collect, and Exterminate

Analysis: Identify the type of entity by observing the unique behaviors it exhibits.

Strategy: Trust no one—not even your friends—but never stay alone.

Extermination: Vanquish the darkness by gathering the necessary items and performing the unique combinations specifically designed for each entity.

Far more than an ordinary horror game, Redast invites you on a true detective adventure with a dynamic structure that changes with every mission. Gather your team, observe, piece together the evidence, and survive.

We would like to thank Haktan Altunkaya for allowing us to use his music in our trailer. You can listen to the song “Özgürüm” on Spotify. Visit Haktan Altunkaya’s YouTube channel here: ⁨@haktanaltunkaya
